'''Ironarm''' was the nickname of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] veteran [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|stormtrooper commander]]. He was one of the first recruits into the reformed [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and served in a brutal but efficient manner without distinction until his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was assigned to hunt a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] [[Unidentified Jedi (Ironarm)|survivor]]. The mission cost him his unit and his right arm. The stormtroopers speculated on whether the nickname was from his [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] or because he strangled the Jedi with the other arm. Whenever the Jedi was mentioned, Ironarm merely got a pitiless glint in his eye. He carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] as his weapon.

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was placed in charge of a quick reaction force of [[cavetrooper]]s to guard the deposits of [[rubat]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. His forces encountered a group of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] there.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ironarm appears in the [[2015]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Hidden Depths]]'', by [[Fantasy Flight Games]]. His comments to the players change upon their success during the adventure, but he must be encountered. The book leaves his fate open-ended, allowing the players to defeat or kill him. If he is defeated, he may return as a recurring character seeking vengeance, or he may be reassigned by his superiors.
